.codespace/architecture.json.summary: This repository's architecture: its layers, and each file's layer, tags, and summary, which the map reads.

README.md.summary: What Codespace is, how to run it, and how an agent drives the map over MCP.

docs/FUTURE.md.summary: Ideas deliberately deferred, written so they can be picked up later.

docs/architecture.md.summary: The architecture file: its fields, the tag vocabulary, and the rules for generated code.

docs/review-rubric.md.summary: The code-health review rubric for a change set in this repository.

package-lock.json.summary: The locked dependency tree, generated by npm.

package.json.summary: The project's name, scripts, and dependencies.

public/city.js.summary: Lays the folder tree out as a treemap and turns each file into a positioned box.

public/controls.js.summary: Wires the buttons, slider, and extras toggle, and polls the repository to redraw the map when it changes.

public/edges.js.summary: Draws imports: bundled strands between folders, direct strands for a chosen file, and pillars from lifted files to the floor.

public/highlight.js.summary: Paints files and folder tiles to match the current selection and hover.

public/index.html.summary: The page: the canvas, the panels, and the controls the map is drawn into.

public/labels.js.summary: Places the HTML name labels over the 3D scene without letting them overlap.

public/main.js.summary: Boots the page: picking and hover with the pointer, the per-frame render loop, and the first load.

public/meshes.js.summary: Builds the 3D shapes (file boxes, folder tiles, layer planes, ground grid) and moves the camera.

public/panels.js.summary: Fills the info, legend, and folders panels, lists a chosen file's functions and variables, and opens a chosen symbol's source.

public/repo.js.summary: Reads the repository through the server into folder nodes, import edges, line counts, tags, layers, and summaries.

public/state.js.summary: The shared world: constants, the Babylon scene and camera, and every mutable value the other modules read.

public/style.css.summary: The page's stylesheet: the panels, labels, and controls.

public/view.js.summary: Listens for what tools ask the map to show, lights those files up, and lists them with their explanations.

src/mcp/Mcp.ts.summary: The stdio fallback for agents that cannot use HTTP MCP: it turns tool calls into requests to the running Codespace.

src/mcp/McpTools.ts.summary: The MCP tools both transports share, and the JSON-RPC answers to them: read the map, shape the architecture, and point at files.

src/repo/Architecture.ts.summary: Reads and safely changes a repository's architecture file: the layers, tags, and summaries the map shows.

src/repo/Graph.ts.summary: Reads the relative imports between code files into a graph the tools can query.

src/repo/Repo.ts.summary: Reads a folder as a repository: lists its files, honours .gitignore, and reads source safely.

src/server/Api.ts.summary: The endpoints tools and the page use: read the architecture and graph, change the architecture, control what the map shows, and speak MCP at /mcp.

src/server/Guard.ts.summary: Decides who may change anything: only requests from this machine, as a local host name, as JSON, from this site.

src/server/Server.ts.summary: Serves the page, the repository API, and the MCP endpoint at /mcp, which starts with the server.

src/server/View.ts.summary: Holds what the map is asked to show and streams changes to every page that is watching.

tests/Api.test.ts.summary: Tests the API: reads, refused changes, validation, the view and its replay to a late page.

tests/Architecture.test.ts.summary: Tests that the architecture file is read and trimmed, and that stale or malformed entries are reported.

tests/Mcp.test.ts.summary: Tests that the MCP server speaks the protocol, turns tool calls into requests, and says how to start Codespace when it is down.

tests/Repo.test.ts.summary: Tests that Repo lists readable files, refuses paths and symlinks outside the repository, and follows .gitignore.

tsconfig.json.summary: The TypeScript compiler settings for the project.
